items.title: Ext commutes with a flat base change below the pseudo-coherence bound

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that tensoring with a flat module commutes with Hom and, below the pseudo-coherence bound, with the higher Ext groups, and the proof is a 28-line argument through a chosen free resolution. It resolves the first module by free modules, computes both sides of the comparison as the cohomology of the Hom complexes built from that resolution, exhibits the canonical map between those complexes, and then uses flatness to identify the cohomology of the tensored complex; the deeper statement follows because pseudo-coherence at the given bound allows the resolution to be chosen finitely free in the relevant degrees, making the map an isomorphism there. The choice of resolution and the degree estimate are the two ingredients, and both are displayed.
